query: Save my changes and push — I added a new responsive nav component plus its composable and the page that uses it on branch MD-1660-responsive-nav.
expected_behavior: Gathers state with git status and git diff before deciding on grouping
Keeps the component, its composable, and the page in a single commit since they serve one feature rather than over-splitting
Generates a conventional commit message (feat(scope): description) with a subject under 70 chars and references the MD-1660 issue from the branch name
Presents the message for approval via AskUserQuestion and commits with a HEREDOC, with no Co-Authored-By line
Pushes once (using -u if no upstream exists) and reports the commit and push result
